items.exampleEn: A harrow has rows of metal teeth that break up the soil.
items.exampleZh: 耙上有好幾排金屬齒，可以把土弄碎。

items.exampleEn: A rhinoceros has thick gray skin and one or two horns on its nose.
items.exampleZh: 犀牛有厚厚的灰色皮膚，鼻子上有一或兩支角。

items.exampleEn: An old scythe hangs on the wall of the barn.
items.exampleZh: 穀倉的牆上掛著一把舊的長柄大鐮刀。

items.exampleEn: The hatching of the turtle eggs usually happens at night.
items.exampleZh: 海龜蛋通常在夜裡孵化。

items.exampleEn: The cat lay in a warm sunbeam on the kitchen floor.
items.exampleZh: 貓躺在廚房地板上一道溫暖的陽光裡。

items.exampleEn: The Tropic of Cancer passes through Chiayi and Hualien.
items.exampleZh: 北迴歸線通過嘉義和花蓮。

items.exampleEn: Astronauts sent back photos of the moonscape.
items.exampleZh: 太空人傳回了月球表面的照片。
items.glossZh: 月球表面；（似月面的）荒涼景觀

items.sentenceEn: These fruits grow well in the tropics, where it is warm all year.
items.sentenceZh: 這些水果在熱帶地區長得很好，那裡全年溫暖。

items.audioEn: A rhinoceros can weigh more than two tons, but it can still run quite fast.
items.audioZh: 犀牛可以重達兩噸以上，但仍然跑得相當快。
items.questionZh: 說話者提到犀牛的什麼特點？
options: It weighs less than a ton
It sleeps most of the day
It is faster than it looks

items.sentenceEn: The rhinoceros walked slowly down to the river to drink.
items.sentenceZh: 那頭犀牛慢慢走到河邊喝水。

items.sentenceEn: The lava fields near the volcano look like a moonscape.
items.sentenceZh: 火山附近的熔岩區看起來像月球表面。

items.stemEn: Before machines, farmers cut the wheat by hand with a ____.
items.stemZh: 在有機器之前，農夫用長柄大鐮刀親手割麥子。

items.stemEn: A thin ____ shone through the clouds and lit up the lake.
items.stemZh: 一道細細的陽光穿過雲層，照亮了湖面。

items.passageEn: My uncle runs a small farm at the edge of the hills, and last summer I stayed with him for two weeks. Every morning, he pulled an old harrow across the fields to prepare them for planting. In the afternoons, I helped him carry hay into the barn. The best moment of my visit was the hatching of the duck eggs. We sat quietly in the barn while a sunbeam fell across the straw, and one by one, the little ducks came out of their shells.
items.passageZh: 我舅舅在山邊經營一座小農場，去年夏天我在他那裡住了兩個星期。每天早上，他都拉著一把舊耙走過田地，替播種做準備。下午我幫他把乾草搬進穀倉。這次拜訪最美好的時刻是鴨蛋孵化。我們靜靜坐在穀倉裡，一道陽光灑在稻草上，小鴨子一隻接一隻破殼而出。

options: 拉著一把舊耙整理田地

questions.questionZh: 作者覺得這次拜訪最美好的時刻是什麼？

items.promptZh: 這種鳥只住在熱帶地區。
referenceEn: This kind of bird lives only in the tropics.
This bird is only found in the tropics.
rubricZh: 「熱帶地區」用 tropic 的複數並加 the（例如 in the tropics）
「只」可放的位置不只一種（例如 lives only in、only lives in、is only found in 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 moonscape 造一個句子，描述一個你去過、看起來很荒涼的地方。
referenceEn: The desert I visited last year looked like a moonscape.
I once hiked across gray hills that looked like a moonscape.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 moonscape（例如 looked like a moonscape）
時態配合內容（例如 looked、look 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：北迴歸線通過嘉義、花蓮，不是「台灣中部」（裁示：事實）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："The Tropic of Cancer passes through the middle of Taiwan."；改後："The Tropic of Cancer passes through Chiayi and Hualien."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：北迴歸線通過嘉義、花蓮，不是「台灣中部」（裁示：事實）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："北迴歸線通過台灣的中部。"；改後："北迴歸線通過嘉義和花蓮。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：專名同步
執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 4：與單字卡用字一致
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："回歸線"；改後："迴歸線"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：裁示「聽選正解不可照抄音檔」：正解改寫成同義說法，干擾項沿用音檔裡的字
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["It lives in cold places", "It sleeps most of the day", "It eats only fruit", "It can run quite quickly"]；改後：["It weighs less than a ton", "It sleeps most of the day", "It eats only fruit", "It is faster than it looks"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：【疑慮6判定】北迴歸線實際通過嘉義（一般歸南部／雲嘉南）與花蓮，「the middle of Taiwan／台灣的中部」不精確，疑似違反§11.10地理描述須符合事實；建議改 passes through southern-central Taiwan／通過台灣中南部，或只寫 passes through Taiwan。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/5 的修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：【疑慮7判定】hatching 依單元主題教「孵化」可接受（例句與閱讀一致，影線並列）；不需改。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 審題員判定可接受，不改。
